entries.en: Rammbroes explains that four varieties of an extremely rare abrasive known as aethersand are required to polish the flawless crystals. Take the purse given to you by the dig supervisor and deliver it to Serendipity, the master of the Goldsmiths' Guild in Ul'dah. It is Rammbroes's hope that the presence of a celebrated adventurer will prompt the goldsmiths to redouble their efforts to procure the required materials.
entries.fr: Rammbroes vous a expliqué que les cristaux purs ne peuvent être façonnés qu'avec un abrasif spécial et très rare connu sous le nom de “sables éthéréens”. Ayant passé une commande à la guilde des orfèvres d'Ul'dah, il vous a confié  pour que vous alliez récupérer la précieuse matière auprès du maître de guilde, Serendipity.

entries.en: Upon arriving at the Goldsmiths' Guild, you encounter an old friend: Biggs. By some strange coincidence, it appears that the Roegadyn engineer is also intent on purchasing what little aethersand there is to be had. After a somewhat one-sided negotiation, he relinquishes his questionable claim on the only available batch in exchange for a role in the forthcoming expedition. The fire-aspected aethersand thus secured, inquire as to whether Biggs might know where to obtain the three remaining varieties.
entries.fr: Alors que vous remettiez le paiement pour l'abrasif dont a besoin Rammbroes, vous avez croisé un visage familier en la personne de Biggs, l'ingénieur roegadyn des Forges de Garlond, qui est lui aussi en quête de sable éthéréen. Après des négociations à sens unique, il a finalement accepté de vous céder le coûteux abrasif en échange de sa participation à l'expédition pour la Tour de Cristal. Parlez-lui de nouveau pour savoir où il pense que vous pourriez trouver un autre type de sable éthéréen.

entries.en: Biggs reveals that his partner, Wedge, has traveled to northern Thanalan to meet with a merchant rumored to be in possession of a quantity of earth-aspected aethersand. Make for Bluefog and seek the Lalafell, who should be accompanied by a hired adventurer bodyguard.

entries.en: According to the adventurer hired to guard Wedge, she last saw her employer during a bungled attempt to retrieve some aethersand which had been stolen by bandits. Betraying scarcely a hint of shame, the bumbling bodyguard speculates that Wedge may still be trapped inside the abandoned Amajina mythril mine which the bandits call home. Make haste to the site and rescue Biggs's stricken friend before it is too late.

Malheureusement, ils ont été découverts et elle a dû abandonner Wedge dans le repaire des brigands lors de leur fuite. Allez à la mine de mithril abandonnée d'Amajina et retrouvez le camarade de Biggs avant qu'il ne soit trop tard.

entries.en: After delivering the two samples of aethersand, you regale Cid with tales of his indefatigable employees' most recent misadventures. When thoughts subsequently turn to the two outstanding varieties of aethersand, Rammbroes declares that he has made “arrangements” to procure them. Quite what form these arrangements may take is unclear, but his expression betrays no small amount of apprehension...

entries.en: Well, I say “substances,” but one might just as well call them one substance─namely “aethersand”─which has four elementally aspected varieties. Alas, aethersand is neither common nor cheap. Indeed, it is not unusual for the abrasive to exceed the value of the precious stones it is used to polish.
entries.fr: Les substances dont je veux parler sont connues communément sous le nom de “sables éthéréens”, et comme les éléments auxquels ils se rapportent, il en existe quatre sortes. Malheureusement, ils sont loin d'être courants ni bon marché. On dit même que leur valeur dépasse celle des pierres précieuses sur lesquelles on les emploie.

entries.en: Given the rarity of the materials in question, the Goldsmiths' Guild in Ul'dah seemed the likeliest place to purchase the quantity we require. When I contacted the guildmaster, however, I was informed that no aethersand was currently available. Though I requested that word be sent as soon as new stock came in, I have yet to receive aught but apologies. I should mention at this point that I placed the order some time before you procured the flawless crystals...

entries.en: I am well aware that acquiring aethersand is no small feat, of course, and I am not an impatient man─but I fear the more we delay our investigation, the greater the risk that the tower's secrets may fall into the hands of other...less savory parties.

Anyway, when we arrived, the man claimed his stock had been stolen by bandits.

entries.en: Determined not to return empty-handed, we crept into the bandits' stronghold and set about locating the stolen goods. Long story short, alarums were raised, rogues were awoken, and we fled in a blind panic. I was separated from my employer in the confusion and I've not seen him since. Hm? Oh. A friend of yours, is he?
entries.fr:
Histoire de ne pas avoir fait le trajet pour rien, nous nous sommes infiltrés dans le repaire des bandits et avons cherché les biens volés. Pour faire court, quelqu'un a donné l'alarme, les brigands se sont tous réveillés, et nous avons dû prendre nos jambes à notre cou.
Moi et mes camarades avons été séparés de notre employeur pendant notre fuite et je ne l'ai pas revu depuis...

entries.fr: Hmph. Ces deux-là sont farouchement motivés. Je n'ai aucune chance de pouvoir me reposer sur mes lauriers avec deux employés aussi zélés.

entries.en: I jest, of course. It will be good to have them around. Still, as a matter of professional pride, let's endeavor to procure the two remaining varieties of aethersand before they arrive, shall we? Tell me, Rammbroes─have we any information on where the water- and wind-aspected types might be hiding?
entries.fr: Je plaisante, bien sûr. Mais que diriez-vous d'obtenir les deux types de sables éthéréens restants avant que Biggs et Wedge n'arrivent ? Avons-nous une quelconque idée d'où pourraient se trouver les abrasifs d'eau et de vent ?
entries.ja:

entries.en: Forgive me for observing, but you seem less than enthusiastic about that prospect. If there's a complication, I'd rather we discuss it now than risk jeopardizing the expedition.
